persona.title: The Circle
persona.speaksAs: Kinetik Circle speaks as the calm friend who already has the plan — never a boss, never a tracker.

beliefHeadline.en: A family isn't managed. It's in rhythm.

id.w25: Kinetik Circle menjaga ritme rumah: rencana, orang, dan momen dalam satu tempat yang tenang — dibangun atas partisipasi, bukan pelacakan.
